niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces that feel complete, structured, and information-rich, with clear labels, visible actions, and strong hierarchy. They like layouts that use space efficiently without feeling empty, and they consistently favor screens that look finished, app-native, and easy to scan. They also tend to prefer lighter, airier presentation in some contexts, but want enough content density to avoid blank or placeholder-like screens.

criteria.description: Prefers screens that feel fully populated, finished, and not sparse or placeholder-like.
Prefers strong visual hierarchy with prominent titles, clear section separation, and obvious focal points.
Prefers layouts that use vertical space well and show enough content to feel useful, while avoiding awkward empty gaps.
Prefers explicit labels, descriptive row text, and content that explains what each item or setting is.
Prefers uniform row styling and consistent control types across a screen, rather than mixed or unfinished behaviors.
Prefers obvious, easy-to-find primary actions such as add, replace, or unblock buttons.
Prefers dialogs and alerts that remain visually connected to the underlying app context instead of feeling isolated or detached.
Prefers short, direct, and easy-to-scan copy over long explanatory or verbose text.
Prefers interfaces that feel modern, intentional, and polished rather than draft-like or experimental.
Prefers obvious row affordances such as chevrons, toggles, and action buttons that make interaction paths easy to understand.
